title: タイ・インドネシア合同 – 日系企業向けBCセミナー:『海外拠点の“見えないコスト”をどう改善するか？』 ～ Business Centralと最新AI機能で実現する業務最適化 と 経営基盤強化～
summary: This seminar introduces Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and its latest AI capabilities for optimizing overseas operations and business efficiency. It covers BC fundamentals, real-world use cases across multiple locations, and practical demonstrations for companies considering ERP adoption or business process standardization.
key_points: Business Central enables data visibility and management standardization across multiple overseas locations
Latest AI features optimize operations and enhance business management decision-making
BC implementation supports companies managing distributed systems with fragmented information
Seminar targets companies in Southeast Asia exploring ERP solutions and digital transformation
